verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent's actions did not cause this outcome. It navigated to the page, used the visible Continue button, waited for the next step, then retried with Enter and another Continue click. Those are reasonable recovery attempts for the stated flow. The app stayed on the first wizard step, so this was not caused by a wrong click, bad timing, or bad test data.
